entities.name: Advent of Islam and Julfar
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The conversion of the Gulf coast tribes to Islam, the Ridda Wars in the region, the emergence of Julfar (near modern Ras al-Khaimah) as a significant port, and early Islamic maritime trade.
